items.title: Warsh at Jackson Hole, Nvidia Earnings: What to Watch Next Week
items.summary: It’s late August, but the coming week will be a big one for markets. Headline events include Nvidia earnings after the bell Wednesday and Kevin Warsh’s first major policy speech as Federal Reserve chairman on Friday.

items.title: Microsoft Stock Gets Cheaper Only If The Forecast Arrives
items.summary: Consensus earnings do the work on the multiple, and none of that work is a fact yet.

items.title: What Adobe Stock's Low Earnings Multiple Is Actually Priced On
items.summary: Adobe stock trades well below the market on earnings, and the subscription book that has to produce the next set of them is one the company has chosen to grow more slowly.

items.title: Zoom Stock Is Priced Three Separate Ways At Once
items.summary: The stock is cheaper than the market on earnings, close to double the market on sales, and level with it on cash flow.

items.title: Salesforce Rallies Into Earnings as Agentforce Tops $1 Billion
items.summary: Investors are betting AI demand can support another strong quarter.

items.title: AI Chip Titan Nvidia Headlines Earnings Calendar; Salesforce, Intuit Also On Deck
items.summary: Salesforce, Workday, Intuit are also on deck along with DollarTree, Williams-Sonoma, Zoom Communications, Rubrik and Heico.

items.title: Countdown to Salesforce (CRM) Q2 Earnings: A Look at Estimates Beyond Revenue and EPS
items.summary: Beyond analysts' top-and-bottom-line estimates for Salesforce (CRM), evaluate projections for some of its key metrics to gain a better insight into how the business might have performed for the quarter ended July 2026.

items.title: Salesforce Vs. ServiceNow: The Platform Play is On as AI Capital Pivots
items.summary: Salesforce and ServiceNow both planted their flags on agentic AI this quarter, but their bets look almost nothing alike, and only one of those bets prices in the risk of being wrong.
